name: Codesign-in-release fix + comprehensive CI
summary: Patch release. Fixes a shipped-binary bug — goreleaser built with CGO_ENABLED=0, which silently dropped the cgo code-signature collector, so released binaries did no codesign checks (v0.5.0 was affected). Rebuilds with cgo + a compile-time guard, and restructures the Actions pipeline so a release passes the exact same comprehensive gate as CI.

required.title: Build releases with cgo so codesign ships
required.summary: codesign_darwin.go carries import "C" (Security.framework); Go drops every cgo file under CGO_ENABLED=0, so the goreleaser build shipped binaries with NO code-signature checks (trust/notarization/revocation/unsigned all gone). Fixed: .goreleaser.yaml CGO_ENABLED=1 with a per-arch CC (clang -arch x86_64) so the amd64 slice cross-compiles with cgo on the arm64 macOS runner; verified goreleaser builds both arches + the universal binary.
evidence: goreleaser snapshot build succeeds on macOS runner (CI release-build job)
measured: CGO=0 build has 0 nativeSig symbols, CGO=1 has them

required.title: Compile guard: darwin && !cgo fails the build
required.summary: codesign_cgo_required.go references an undefined identifier under `darwin && !cgo`, so a no-cgo darwin build fails to compile instead of silently shipping crippled. A successful release build now proves cgo is on; the CI goreleaser-snapshot job trips the guard if CGO regresses.
evidence: CGO_ENABLED=0 go build fails with the guard message; default cgo build passes

required.title: Reusable checks gate + release-build validation
required.summary: checks.yml (workflow_call) is the single releasable-gate — gofmt, vet, build, race tests, coverage ≥80%, Codecov — called by both CI and Release, so a tag passes the same bar as CI. CI push triggers fixed (feat/**,swarm/** → main,develop) and a goreleaser snapshot build runs every push/PR.
evidence: CI run on PR #35: checks + release-build both green

workstreams.name: CI & release hardening
workstreams.summary: Found and fixed a release-build bug (codesign dropped under CGO=0) while making the Actions pipeline comprehensive: one reusable gate shared by CI and Release, release-build validation on every run, and a compile guard so the codesign regression can never ship again.
evidence: goreleaser snapshot build (cgo, both arches + universal)

evidence.label: PR #35 CI: reusable checks + release-build (goreleaser snapshot, cgo) both green
